prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1497; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured vehicle reported a left-turn collision at an intersection with an oncoming sedan. Driver of the other vehicle reports airbag deployment and is complaining of headache and dizziness. Scene photos requested. Claimant stated they are not represented by counsel.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant reports loss of consciousness for a short period at the scene, nausea, and ongoing light sensitivity. Claimant has been advised to obtain medical evaluation and to keep records of all treatment. Claimant confirmed no attorney retained at this time.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report. Responding officer noted the insured was turning left on a green-arrow signal and the other vehicle entered the intersection against a red light. Liability appears to favor the claimant, pending witness statement confirmation. Injury notes flagged for medical review.

Entry 4: Claimant's treating physician has diagnosed a concussion and recommended a period of rest with restricted screen time and work limitations. Records requested with signed authorization. Claimant asked how the claim process works and was given a general overview of the bodily injury and property damage coverages.

Entry 5: Follow-up call completed. Claimant reports headaches have eased somewhat but memory lapses continue. Claimant remains unrepresented and has been informed of the right to seek legal counsel. File remains open pending medical records and an independent medical review.
